vector_memory.semantic_summary: ColorInspector is a specialized Angular component designed to manage and display a selected color value within an editor's inspection panel. It consumes a Color object via an @Input and emits updates through a colorChange @Output, coordinating interaction with ColorPickerComponent. Its core logic includes a textColor getter that uses the YIQ formula to ensure high-contrast text display against the background color.
